stem: Which statement explains an effect of Samuel Slater’s mill?

options.label: A
options.text: It limited the need for child labor in factories.

options.label: B
options.text: It limited the need for interchangeable parts.

options.label: C
options.text: It led to expanded regulations on foreign trade.

options.label: D
options.text: It led to rapid growth in the textile industry.

visual_elements: Box with bullet points: inspired by ideas from Great Britain; built in Pawtucket, Rhode Island, in 1793; first water-powered factory in the United States.
